processing steps: Ran naive fuzzy-match generator (generate_mentions.py, max_edit_distance=3, bare name-segment matching enabled) against mentioned_people_with_ids.json, producing a 6,468-entry draft: 286 exact literal alias matches (no notes field) plus 6,182 lower-confidence FUZZY MATCH / SEGMENT MATCH / AMBIGUOUS candidates flagged for manual review.

Ran validate_mentions.py on the raw naive draft: Rule A and Rule B passed with zero errors; Rule C (unmarked literal matches) returned ~1,054 warnings, almost entirely single 3-4 letter Polish stopword fragments (e.g. "ani", "jaki", "przy") produced by the fuzzy/segment matcher, not real name mentions.

Since only 18 unique text strings accounted for all 286 exact matches, built a custom stem-based scanner (diacritic-insensitive, word-boundary-anchored name-prefix matching, tuned per name length) over the full transcript against every entity name/alias to recover genuine grammatical/typo variants the naive generator's pure edit-distance approach missed or buried in noise. This produced 290 unique matched surface forms across 2,076 raw hits.

Manually reviewed all 290 unique surface forms with transcript context (grouped by token, with example lines) to classify each as: (a) a genuine mention of a specific entity - accepted for every occurrence (e.g. Angela/Aniela/Anieli -> Aniela Olszewska id 77; Wąsik/Kuba -> Jakub Łysiak id 8; Meciński/Kaśka/Katarzyna(ciński) typo family -> Katarzyna Meciński id 7; Gonciarz/Krzysztof/Krzysiek -> Krzysztof Gonciarz id 1); (b) a genuine mention only in specific instances where the surface form is ambiguous or coincides with a common Polish word (e.g. "Hanny"/"Karoliny"/"Kasie"/"Julia"/"Maciek"/"sylwester" - resolved case-by-case using surrounding lines, especially multi-line continuations onto a surname); or (c) pure noise from stem collisions with common Polish words or unrelated entities and discarded entirely (e.g. "ale", "dziewczyna", "pani", "Superwizjer" [the TV show, not Jarosław Jabrzyk], "Sobczak" [a different real person, Zofia Sobczak, not Kryspin Sobczak], "stalkerem/stalkingu" [generic accusation vocabulary], "Stanów" ["United States", not Krzysztof Stanowski]).

Cross-checked the full entity list against the transcript by literal grep for ~40 additional less-central names (Kryspin Sobczak, Ewa Wyczółkowska, Justyna Mazur, Paulina T, Jaś Kapela, Maja Staśko, etc.) to confirm none of them silently appear in this episode beyond what was already captured.

Re-ran validate_mentions.py on the reconciled set: Rule A and Rule B both pass. Investigated all remaining Rule C flags individually; found and added 4 further genuine typo'd forms of "Wardenga" ("Wartenga", "Wardęga", "Wartęga", "Wardęi"). The remaining 5 Rule C flags are confirmed false positives (documented in notes) and were deliberately left unmarked.
Final validator run: Rule A (Name/ID Consistency) passed, Rule B (Transcript Alignment) passed, Rule C shows only the 5 documented/reviewed non-issues.
Claude Sonnet 5 refinement with naive generator and validator.
notes: This episode's naive draft used a different (fuzzy edit-distance) generator than prior episodes and was extremely noisy (6,468 raw candidates, of which only 286 were literal exact matches); most of the raw draft was discarded as false positives rather than fixed in place. Five reviewed Rule C flags were deliberately left unmarked as false positives: (1) [07:20] "Sylwestra" is "Sylwestra 2015 roku" (New Year's Eve 2015), not a reference to Sylwester Wardenga; (2) [30:05] and (3) [01:55:50] "olał" are substrings inside the unrelated verb forms "Wolałbym"/"wolałabyś" ("I would prefer"), not the alias "Olał"/Ola (Olciak, id 35); (4) [01:56:56] and (5) [01:57:21] "Kasie" both mean "at the cash register" ("Pracowałem na Kasie"), not the person Katarzyna Meciński. One mention was flagged AMBIGUOUS and resolved by judgement call rather than certainty: at [02:08:58] "Julia jego była powinna go pozwać" was assigned to Julia Wieliczko (id 3) rather than Julia Bojaruniec (id 27) based on the personal/relationship context, but this is a judgement call rather than a certainty and is flagged in that mention's own notes field.
